seo.description:
The wellness of our time.
Inspired by the tranquil bamboo forests of Korea, the Bamboo Forest scented candle by Leverden embodies modern K-Spirit and K-Ritual wellness. This natural candle is designed to purify the environment, create a sanctuary of well-being, and reconnect you with nature through scent.

The fragrance evokes a fresh, light breeze moving through lush bamboo forests—clean, green, and quietly grounding. Subtle yet mindful, it calms the senses, soothes the spirit, and brings serenity to any interior space.

Crafted with a natural coconut-apricot wax blend, this candle delivers a clean, conscious burn without paraffin, making it one of the most sustainable candle wax options available today.

Paraben-free & kosher

nodes.title: Shaman Scented Candle
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Ground your spirit using the Shaman Candle to light up your space. And let a tapestry of scents guide you through a mindful journey. The head notes of Artemisia, with its green, crisp edges, sweep through your space, clearing the mind. Cypress follows, its woody depth working to still your thoughts and quiet the mind, setting a sacred stage for reflection and tranquility.

In the heart notes, the sacred Palo Santo carries with it the whispers of ancient shamanic rituals, its revered smokiness enriched by the floral notes of Geranium, to energize and protect, crafting a haven for positivity and creation.

As the experience deepens, the base notes of Sandalwood and

Vetiver oil emerge, grounding you with their earthy, resonant calm.

With each flicker of the flame, you contribute to the preservation of ancient wisdom and the sustainable harvesting of Palo Santo, promoting harmony with nature.

nodes.title: Valley of Roses Scented Candle
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Transport yourself to a mystical landscape draped in floral splendor with our Valley of Roses Candle. This aromatic masterpiece begins with the delicate fragrance of Moroccan Rose Petals, intertwined with the crisp essence of Dewy Leaf accord and the subtle spiciness of Elemi. These head notes conjure the first blush of morning in a lush rose valley, inviting you to breathe deeply and relax into the scent’s natural elegance.

As the candle burns, it reveals a heart of Fresh Cut Moroccan Rose accord, rich and intoxicating, perfectly paired with the spicy warmth of Clove and the sweet touch of Geranium. This heart sings of midday in a sunlit garden, where every breeze is perfumed with the depth and complexity of blooming roses, offering a sensory escape to the heart of Morocco's famed valleys.

The journey concludes with a grounding base of Patchouli, Creamy Sandalwood, and Sheer Musk, accented by the robust earthiness of Cedarwood. These notes provide a soothing finale, echoing the serene dusk in the rose valley, where the air settles into a fragrant calm, and the spirit is lulled into a state of peaceful reflection.

nodes.title: Bushman Candle Myrrh Protection Bar
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Handmade Bar Soap with Wild Myrrh from the Namibian Desert

Description
The Bushman Candle Myrrh Protection Bar is crafted with wild Myrrh sourced directly from the Himba community in the Namibian desert. For generations, Myrrh has been used in the region as a natural way to protect the skin from harsh sunlight, dryness, and environmental stress.

Leverden reinterprets this tradition into a modern body-care ritual.
Hand-poured by our artisan soap maker, this bar cleanses gently while delivering the soothing, moisturizing benefits of plant-based oils and naturally occurring glycerin. The warm, resinous Myrrh aroma leaves a soft desert-inspired finish on the skin.

nodes.value:
Wet your hands or body and start lathering the soap.

Gently massage the foam over your skin to benefit from its protective and nourishing oils.

After use, hang the soap by its rope to air-dry and extend its lifespan.

This bar soap fuses the sensory elegance of a spa-invitation scent with efficient skincare performance. With its protective plant oils and heritage-rich myrrh, it’s more than a cleansing bar—it’s a moment of ceremony and care each time you lather.

Sodium hydroxide, Cocos nucifera (coconut) oil, Aqua (water), Helianthus annuus (sunflower) seed oil, Olea europaea (olive) fruit oil, Simmondsia chinensis (jojoba) seed oil, Ricinus communis (castor) seed oil, Prunus armgd­alus dulcis (sweet almond) oil, Butyrospermum parkii (shea) butter, Myrrh (Commiphora myrrha) oil, Fragrance (parfum)

Handmade with care in Korea, featuring a hanging linen-blend rope for simple display or daily use

Infused with myrrh oil harvested in collaboration with the Himba tribe’s ancestral rituals—will help you feel grounded and energized

Premium plant-based cleansing blend: coconut oil, olive oil, jojoba seed oil, castor seed oil + natural glycerin

Hanging-cord allows easy drying and extended longevity; once the soap is finished, the rope is biodegradable
